note: Current capability support; shortcut verdicts are the historical 2026-11-05 audit. Execution is decided by validateCommand, CommandBus handlers and Copilot planners.

capabilities.label: Create 2D line / polyline / rectangle / circle / arc
preconditions: 2D workspace
active layer is visible and unlocked (routeCadShortcut drawingAvailable)
MCP: output layer visible and unlocked; new ID not in use
limitations: MCP curve.polyline needs coplanar vertices parallel to its origin plane, distinct consecutive points, ≥3 points when closed
MCP has no arc tool; arcs are created only through UI tools

capabilities.label: Move selection
preconditions: selection exists and is editable (routeCadShortcut: hasSelection && selectionEditable)
limitations: assertEditableCommandTargets rejects derived outputs: model projections/sections, construction outputs, pattern instances, planar faces, published sheet geometry
MCP scene.objects refuses one derived output: 'Move the owning sketch or drawing view, not one derived output.'
Direct transforms are rejected while an exploded display offset applies to the part

capabilities.label: Base-point copy and paste (Clipboard pilot)

surfaces: UCS / Clipboard pilot → Copy base point, then Paste at target → Review/Apply

preconditions: copy: 1–64 objects and a finite world base point
copy: each object visible on a visible layer, a `drawing` feature with no inputs (independent)
paste: clipboard came from the same document ID; every member layer is visible and unlocked
limitations: only line, polyline, rectangle, circle, arc and point drawings
rejects sketch-owned, model-projection, construction, pattern and parameter-bound drawings ('need X4-A2')
same document only: copyDrawingClipboard stores documentId and both clipboardPasteCommand and the handler reject another document
in-memory module clipboard, not the OS clipboard; it does not survive a reload and is per editor iframe
pasted members are new independent drawings with new IDs and regenerated topology

evidence.symbol: Clipboard pilot is limited to the same document

capabilities.label: Create dimension annotation (linear / aligned / radius)
preconditions: one supported source selected (planDimensionFromSelection)
limitations: MCP draft.linearDimension creates a static measured dimension and needs a nonzero span in its orientation

capabilities.label: Edit dimension annotations and reuse linear dimension styles
preconditions: a dimension annotation is selected; presets require visible linear dimensions on unlocked layers
limitations: Named presets snapshot unit, precision, arrow size and text height. Apply copies values, with no live link to the preset
Preset application preserves measurements, references, driving values and other annotation settings
Angular, radial and chain annotations use their existing edit paths; no DXF DIMSTYLE interchange

capabilities.label: Change a driving dimension (solid parameter, sketch dimension, variable)
preconditions: MCP solid.parameter: exactly one selected supported solid; standalone proposal
limitations: dependent features regenerate inside the same transaction; a regeneration failure rejects the whole edit

capabilities.label: Extrude closed profiles
preconditions: selected closed profile(s) (routeCadShortcut: canExtrude)
MCP: profiles are selected visible unlocked sources or outputs of earlier steps
limitations: MCP profile references must be unique
an open profile passes MCP planning and is rejected at Preview by the create-extrude handler ('Selected geometry does not form a closed loop')
the result must pass BRep measurement in prepareCadCommand

capabilities.label: Inspect recorded 2D profile and Extrude relationships

surfaces: Properties → Dependencies → Profile ↔ Extrude → Download relation JSON
Properties → Dependencies → Profile ↔ Extrude → Explain with Auto Ontology (registered snapshot pilot)

preconditions: select one 2D profile candidate or native profile Extrude
limitations: direct recorded inputs only; no geometry matching, feature replay or inferred provenance
live and snapshot follow the existing dependency graph; missing inputs and sketch owners are reported separately
face sketch, hybrid datum and architectural slab variants are outside this query
Inspector and downloadable JSON share the same read-only report
optional Auto Ontology confirmation requires explicit session consent, a server-registered snapshot and matching document revision; defaults disabled
external responses must match native relation facts and the current document/session/generation; timeout and mismatch preserve native results

capabilities.label: Undo
preconditions: no document command pending (isDocumentCommandPending)
a past snapshot exists
limitations: whole-document snapshots, at most 100 entries
session only: cleared on document load, not saved
not exposed to MCP/Copilot; remote Apply is also disallowed

capabilities.label: Redo
preconditions: no document command pending
a future snapshot exists (cleared by any new edit)
limitations: same as Undo

capabilities.label: Layer isolate / unisolate

surfaces: Layers → Isolate selected layers / Exit layer isolation

preconditions: Select existing objects with valid layers, or exit an active layer isolation
limitations: Temporary viewport filter; never changes document visibility, locks, History or exported geometry
Hidden objects/layers remain hidden and locked layers remain locked
Object/layer isolation are mutually exclusive; file open and document switches clear the filter
Not serialized; later explicit document visibility edits are preserved when exiting
No layer freeze, no AutoCAD option syntax, no MCP tool
